fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are a near-verbatim spread of the article page's standalone "newsarticle" JSON-LD block, enriched with keywords/wordCount/commentCount merged in from a companion @graph "Article" node, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, thestatesman.com/googlenews.xml) carry title/link/publicationDate/keywords fields since this site exposes no RSS feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (not_found, http_<code>, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, raw passthrough from JSON-LD.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article content, from the standalone "newsarticle" JSON-LD block (present on every sampled article).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline object as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough -- a single Person dict, e.g. {"@type": "Person", "name": "Statesman News Service", "url": "..."}). Every sampled article carried the generic newsroom byline "Statesman News Service" rather than a named reporter.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image object (url, width, height), from JSON-LD.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Array of topic/keyword tags. In article mode this is merged in from a companion @graph "Article" JSON-LD node (the primary "newsarticle" block never carries it on this site). In latest mode it comes straight from the sitemap's news:keywords element (comma-separated, split into an array).

wordCount.title: Word count
wordCount.description: Upstream-reported article word count, merged in from the companion @graph "Article" JSON-LD node (article mode only).

commentCount.title: Comment count
commentCount.description: Upstream-reported comment count, merged in from the companion @graph "Article" JSON-LD node (article mode only).

url.title: Canonical URL
url.description: Canonical article URL, from JSON-LD (article mode).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap item, from the sitemap's news:title.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL (latest-mode), from the sitemap item's loc.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (latest-mode), from the sitemap item's news:publication_date.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
